Slave_received_heartbeats grows between two reads on a healthy, idle link; read the view again after the heartbeat period to tell an idle source from a broken link.

notes: Seconds_Behind_Master compares the original timestamp of the event being applied with the replica's clock, adjusted by the clock difference measured when the receiver connected. A clock change on either server after that skews it, and one long transaction shows as a jump, so it is never the only lag signal.
